Clear Aligners Should Fix Your Bite,

Invisalign moves teeth with a series of trays — but the result depends entirely on the plan behind them. Mason Park evaluates tooth health, gum condition, jaw function, and how your bite closes before designing a single stage.
A full evaluation of your smile, bite, and goals, plus eLab digital design so you see your result before anything begins.
Trays are worn 20 to 22 hours a day and swapped on schedule, with periodic checks to confirm your teeth are tracking to the plan.
Master-crafted porcelain or refined bonding, fitted and checked against your original design, so what you approved is what you get.
Every smile below started with a conversation, a full examination, and a plan built around that specific patient.
Mason Park Dental sits just off Kingsland Blvd in Katy modern, calm, and built around families who would rather not spend an afternoon at the dentist.
Am I a candidate for Invisalign?

Most crowding, spacing and mild-to-moderate bite issues can be treated with clear aligners. Severe rotations, significant jaw discrepancies and some bite corrections still do better with braces or a specialist referral. A scan and exam tell you definitively — and if you are not a candidate, you will be told at the consultation rather than twelve trays in.

Shorter cases often finish in a few months; comprehensive cases typically run twelve to eighteen. Your digital plan shows the projected number of stages before you start, so you know the timeline before you commit to it.

That is the goal. Your design is based on your facial proportions, lips, natural tooth characteristics, and preferred level of brightness. Shape, texture, and shade are selected so the result looks like it belongs to you - not like a generic set of teeth.
Can I preview the result before treatment?

Yes. Digital smile design can help you see the proposed direction before permanent treatment begins. Depending on your case, a physical trial smile may also let you experience the shape and proportions before final restorations are made.

Expect pressure and tenderness for a day or two after each new tray that pressure is the movement happening. Most patients describe it as noticeable rather than painful, and it settles as the tray beds in.
What does Invisalign cost at Mason Park Dental?

The investment depends on the number of teeth involved, the procedures selected, the materials used, and the complexity of your case. After your evaluation, the team will explain your options and provide a clear estimate before you decide how to proceed. Financing options may be available.

Many plans include an orthodontic benefit that applies to clear aligners, often as a lifetime maximum rather than an annual one. Our team will check your benefits for you. If you do not have insurance, ask about the Mason Park Dental Savings Plan no annual maximum, no deductible, and no waiting period.
The right time to feel good about your smile is always sooner than you think. Find out exactly what’s possible with a free consultation and digital smile preview.
